title: Northaven demo: returns and refunds
text: Synthetic policy, version 1, 16 September 2026. Unused items in unopened original packaging may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a refund of the goods. Customer pays return postage unless faulty or sent in error. Opened glassware, consumables and sterile items cannot be returned for safety, unless faulty or sent in error. Faulty or damaged items are covered for 12 months: replace or refund and Northaven pays return postage; photograph damage before packing. A broken calibration seal incurs a GBP45 recalibration fee. To start a return, email returns@northaven-instruments.example with reference and reason; a returns number and label follow within one working day. Refunds are normally processed within five working days of receipt. These are policy timelines, not evidence that a refund was issued. All email addresses are fictional and do not deliver.

title: Northaven demo: calibration certificates
text: Synthetic policy, version 1, 16 September 2026. Instruments marked calibrated on an order include a UKAS-traceable PDF calibration certificate, normally emailed within five working days of dispatch, not placed in the box. Valid for 12 months from the calibration date. A lost certificate is reissued free within those 12 months: email calibration@northaven-instruments.example with the order reference and instrument serial number. The address is fictional. Issued status proves the certificate was issued; it does not prove email delivery or its date. Annual recalibration needs a person to quote per instrument. Create a support request for a quote, with the customer's email and instrument details; do not invent a price.

title: Northaven demo: delivery and cancellation
text: Synthetic policy, version 1, 16 September 2026. Processing orders normally dispatch within two working days from Sheffield. Awaiting stock has no promised dispatch date; the warehouse emails on dispatch. Tracking becomes available after dispatch. Read carrier, tracking and expected delivery from the order lookup; an expected date is not proof of delivery on that date. Delivered means the order is marked delivered, with no actual delivery timestamp provided by this demo. Cancelled orders are not being sent; any payment is normally refunded within five working days of cancellation, but the lookup does not prove a payment or refund occurred. For overdue or disputed deliveries, offer to create an asynchronous support request; do not claim a live agent is connected. No email is sent by the demo.
